entries.title: A crewmate that only answers starts its project's checks without asking
entries.body: A crewmate that is only answering a question, such as a nightly check, now starts or reruns a run of its own project's checks on GitHub or GitLab at once, so the check no longer waits for your click. Every other change it makes, including cancelling a run, still asks you first.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen; the request card no longer goes up for a run start.
